what_happened: Job 20261113-190407-4318 (code job, retry pem8: add a critic reading check for behavior-test code readings) failed in planning, before any code was written. After the last round (5 of 5) the critic still said the plan needed revising. It judged the plan's seams real and the demonstrations sound. One major finding remained: the plan's survey route for part (c) does not match the reader guide. For a change that adds no record, the guide asks only for "what the records validation allow-list accepts". names_record_evidence rejects the bare word allow-list, and the plan accepts only "no record". Readings that followed the guide would be newly refused, which pushes the replay refusal share toward the 35% hold, and AC4 forbids loosening markers afterwards. Four minor findings: the bare word "order" weakens the (a) marker; the stated reason ("new required labels") is untrue for optional labels; part (b) also accepts docs/ paths though the plan says crates/; and the per-part effect of requiring (c) and (d) on the share is not estimated. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria and no failed checks. Nothing was delivered.
cause: Planning checks that named files and seams exist, but nothing makes the plan run its new refusal rule's markers against the real inputs it must accept: the reader guide's own wording and recorded guide-shaped readings. The plan's (c) survey markers were designed from the reading's wording and from an assumption that they matched the guide. The guide and names_record_evidence disagree on the bare word allow-list, and nothing cross-checked them. Planning has fixed rounds, keeps no partial plan and has no mechanical repair step, so one major finding that survives round 5 loses all planning spend.
other_causes: The refusal-share hold of 35% combined with AC4's ban on loosening markers afterwards leaves the plan no slack. Any marker mismatch with the guide becomes a blocker at planning rather than a tunable after replay.
This is a retry (pem8) of an earlier attempt, and the stored fields do not show that the prior attempt's critic findings were carried into the plan.
open_hypotheses: Whether a repair step or a sixth round would have fixed the (c) route cheaply. The finding looks mechanical, but the fields cannot confirm it.
Whether the real replay share with the guide-matched markers would actually exceed 35%. The critic argues it would, but no measurement is given.
contradictions: The critic found the plan's seams real, the callers covered and the demonstrations valid. Only one major finding remained, so the plan was close to acceptable.
prevention: Before the plan is accepted, run the planned reading rule against the reader guide's own example wording and the recorded real code readings, and have the planner state the refused share per part. Block the plan if any guide-following form is refused. Also let the planner make one mechanical repair pass after the last round when the only major finding concerns marker coverage. This would stop the whole class of refusal-rule plans built from the reading's wording instead of real shapes.
proposed_request: Add a critic reading check for code readings that carry a behavior criterion. The reading must also carry a code survey that covers four parts: (a) the order of operations, (b) an existing crates/ or docs/ path, (c) the record evidence, and (d) a direct check. For part (c), accept the reader guide's own wording ("what the records validation allow-list accepts") as well as "no record", so readings that follow the guide and add no record are not refused. Do not match the bare word "order" for part (a); require a phrase such as "order of operations". Make the reason sentence in the doc comment and CHANGELOG true for optional labels. Say that part (b) accepts docs/ paths as well as crates/ paths. Test the check against the repo's guide-shaped SURVEY fixture and the recorded real code readings. State the refused share per part. The replay share must stay under the 35% hold without loosening markers afterwards. Include a CHANGELOG.md entry.
